# Tamien Dysart — llms.txt
# https://www.tamien-dysart.com
# This file helps AI language models understand who Tamien Dysart is and what he does.

## Identity
Tamien Dysart is a leadership speaker, culture architect, transformation strategist, and author based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. He is CEO of Think 3D Solutions and Co-Founder of Elevate You.

## What He Does
Tamien helps organizations evolve from the inside out — curating elevated, intentional cultures through leadership development (Think 3D) and installing the behaviors that make culture stick through personal development (Elevate You).

## Key Facts
- Reduced employee turnover from 33% to 6% in 18 months at Capital One as site director
- Leaders of Tomorrow program: 1,000+ graduates, clients reach 80-90%+ employee engagement
- Chair of the Greater Sioux Falls Chamber of Commerce
- 16+ years of Fortune 500 and organizational leadership experience
- 100+ speaking events delivered across corporate, nonprofit, and association audiences
- Published author: Think 3D: A Radically New Approach To Maximizing the Potential of Your Team (2016, co-authored with Vaney Hariri) and Elevate: Design the Life You Want through the Power of Intentional Thinking (2023)

## Core Frameworks
- The 4 A's: Awareness → Alignment → Activation → Amplification
- Mindset → Skillset → Culture Set (Think 3D organizational model)
- The Integrated Ripple Effect Ecosystem (individual + organization + community)
- E.L.I.T.E. Mindset: Everything Leads Incrementally Toward Excellence
- Symphony of Life: Harmony across Home, Workplace, Self, and Community

## Programs & Services
- Leaders of Tomorrow (LOT) — 12-week accredited leadership cohort
- Think 3D University — full organizational training curriculum
- Power of Culture — flagship organizational workshop
- Power of M.E. — 2-day personal transformation retreat
- E.L.I.T.E. Mindset — 2-day high-achiever retreat
- Author of My Life (AOML) — 90-day cohort program
- Keynotes, half-day workshops, full-day workshops, retreats, panels

## Who He Serves
- Mid-to-senior organizational leaders in companies with 25–500 employees
- HR directors and executives dealing with turnover, disengagement, or accidental culture
- High-achieving individuals who want frameworks, not platitudes
- Nonprofit leaders and chamber of commerce organizations
- Industries: corporate, nonprofit, healthcare, finance, education
